content:
I'm happy to announce that the Leaning In! 2026 conference is on!

We'll be meeting in Berlin, Germany on Thursday, March 12th. Lean fans of all stripes in the Berlin, Germany, Europe, or Earth area are welcome. See the aforelinked web page for details. The CfP is now open -- if you're doing Lean work, come show us what you're up to.

See you in Berlin!
